data_migration.notes: No migration. v1 appends controller-local events/checkpoints only below an explicit state directory and appends governed FREEZER history in this repository.

risks: Dry-run results may be misread as live external execution
Budget or gate drift must stop or escalate before another attempt
Future provider adapters could accidentally widen authority if added without a new gate
external_interfaces: None in v1; repository-local governed reads and explicit controller-local state writes only
No network, subprocess, shell, provider API, GitHub write, deployment, publication, messaging, scheduling, customer action or adjacent-repository mutation
approval_changes: RTS-FRZ-000006 alone receives APPROVED build authority and an explicit human-approved lifecycle
Controller runtime authority is limited to DRY_RUN_APPROVED and LOCAL_CHECKPOINT_WRITE
RTS-FRZ-000007 remains FROZEN / NOT_APPROVED and unimplemented
existing_assumptions: RTS-FRZ-000004 and RTS-FRZ-000005 are completed on main
Committed FREEZER and Asset Manifest indexes are the governed inputs
events.jsonl is append-only source of truth and checkpoint.json is derived
Dry-run output is SIMULATED_ONLY and never claims external verification
rationale: The work is bounded to a deterministic local controller, explicit authorization contract, dry-run adapter, budgets, state transitions, append-only hash-chained events, checkpoint verification, stop/resume/escalation, focused tests and governed CI. It cannot perform external actions and keeps provider execution outside v1.
affected_boundaries: FREEZER item, Build Assessment, Preflight, indexes and manifest
Read-Only Loop Core completed-child verification boundary
governed CI path filters and validation
rollback_boundary: Revert PR #231. No adjacent repository, external service, credential, provider, deployment, publication, message, schedule, customer state or external side effect is mutated by v1.
hidden_dependencies: Assessment and Preflight fingerprints must remain current across lifecycle-only revisions
Manifest hashes and semantic indexes must be regenerated after governed record changes
Resume requires unchanged input and authorization fingerprints
WIP=1 must hold while the controller item is SELECTED or IN_PROGRESS
Loop Core verification must recognize 000006 as completed while preserving 000007 as future/unapproved
completion_conditions: Only an explicitly authorized current FREEZER item can produce a plan
Plans are deterministic for identical governed inputs and authorization
Only the dry-run adapter and LOCAL_CHECKPOINT_WRITE capability are accepted
Attempts, elapsed time, changed files, changed bytes and events are bounded
Events are append-only and hash chained; checkpoint disagreement fails closed
Retryable failure requires explicit resume and cannot exceed attempt budget
Emergency stop and human escalation are structured and terminal
Execution record uses canonical required fields and is labelled SIMULATED_ONLY
RTS-FRZ-000006 has current BUILD_NOW assessment and PASS Preflight
Lifecycle records show SELECTED, IN_PROGRESS, VERIFIED and COMPLETED
All governed validation, focused tests and Unicode Guard pass
